titel: Why Your Hamster Doesn't Want A Friend

beats.say: Why does your hamster... *not* want a friend?
Rudi thinks his hamster looks *lonely.* So he brings home a buddy.
So Rudi buys a *mansion.* Two floors, two wheels. They fight over one.
The mansion didn't work. So Rudi throws a friendship *party.* They fight over the cake.
Here's the thing. Syrian hamsters are *loners.*
Scientists dug up wild burrows in Syria. Each had just *one* adult.
Their tunnels run up to *nine metres.* All for one hamster.
The RSPCA says they should *always* live on their own.
Give one hamster a big cage, deep bedding, and *you* as its friend.
And if someone says your hamster looks lonely, just ask...
